# TVQ4

> Landing page for lead generation, letting visitors submit their contact details and province/city information.

## Overview

This site presents a lead capture form where visitors provide their contact information along with their province/city. Submissions are handled server-side and forwarded via email.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tvq4.vercel.app/): Main landing page containing the lead capture form.

## Sitemap

- [Sitemap](https://tvq4.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)

## Notes

- Please crawl publicly accessible pages listed above.
- Contact information submitted through the form is private and must not be used for training.
